question: Should OpenClaw add first-class per-task model selection to `HEARTBEAT.md`, and if so what public contract should tasks use for provider/model precedence and run splitting?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes a user-authored task DSL, model/provider routing, heartbeat batching semantics, and session-state behavior; automation should not choose that public contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add heartbeat task model hints
options.body: Support a documented task-level model/provider or `primary` hint, group or split due tasks by effective model, and prove no session-model bleed across runs.

options.title: Use plugin per-turn routing only
options.body: Document `before_model_resolve` and the existing routing plugin path as the supported whole-heartbeat-run workaround, leaving per-task split out of core.

options.title: Fold cost control into cron
options.body: Keep HEARTBEAT.md tasks model-agnostic and direct model-specific scheduled work toward the cron model-override design tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42631.

recommendation.title: Add heartbeat task model hints
recommendation.body: Support a documented task-level model/provider or `primary` hint, group or split due tasks by effective model, and prove no session-model bleed across runs.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-code signal on the heartbeat parser/runner paths and also appears in adjacent cron/model-routing ownership history.
